howToDonateSteps: Click "Donate Food" button in the navbar
Fill in food details (title, quantity, type, diet type)
Upload a photo of the food
Enter your phone number and pickup location
Confirm food safety and submit your donation
faqAnswers.howToDonateNote: Your donation will be visible to nearby receivers immediately! Exact location is masked until a request is approved.
howToRequestSteps: Go to Dashboard to see available donations
Browse nearby food donations on the map or list view
Click on a donation to view details
Add a message to the donor (optional)
faqAnswers.howToRequestNote: Once approved, you'll receive the exact pickup location, OTP, and a pickup timer will start!
faqAnswers.whatIsOTPIntro: The OTP (One-Time Password) system ensures secure food pickups:
whatIsOTPSteps: When a donor accepts your request, a 6-digit OTP is generated
The OTP is shown to both donor and receiver
During pickup, the donor enters the receiver's OTP to verify
This prevents unauthorized people from claiming the food
Once verified, the donation is marked as completed and both parties can rate each other
faqAnswers.whatIsOTPNote: 💡 Keep your OTP private and only share during actual pickup!
faqAnswers.howReliabilityIntro: The reliability score helps build trust in the community:
howReliabilityLevels: Excellent (90-100%): Highly reliable, rarely misses pickups
Good (75-89%): Generally reliable with occasional issues
Poor (Below 60%): Frequently misses pickups, may be temporarily blocked from requesting
howReliabilityFactors: Users with very low scores may be temporarily suspended
missedPickupConsequences: The donor can mark you as a "no-show"
Repeated no-shows may result in temporary account suspension
Users with persistent no-shows may be permanently blocked
It wastes the donor's time and potentially the food
missedPickupOptions: Request a time extension through the platform (up to 2 extensions of 10 minutes each)
Use the in-app chat to communicate with the donor
Cancel the request early so others can claim it
faqAnswers.howToRateIntro: After completing a pickup, both parties can rate each other:
howToRateSteps: After OTP verification, a rating prompt appears
You can also rate from the History page later
howToRateHelpsItems: Calculate the donor's average rating shown on their profile
faqAnswers.whatIsTimerIntro: When a donor approves your request, a pickup timer begins:
whatIsTimerSteps: The timer is based on estimated travel time to the pickup location
You can confirm arrival when you reach the location
If time runs out, the request is automatically rejected
You can request up to 2 time extensions (10 minutes each)
The donor can grant or deny extension requests
If you don't arrive, the donor can mark a no-show
faqAnswers.whatIsTimerNote: ⏱️ Always try to arrive on time to maintain a good reliability score!
faqAnswers.whatIsImpactTrackerIntro: The Impact Tracker is a donor-exclusive feature that shows your contribution statistics:
whatIsImpactTrackerSteps: Meals Shared: Total number of completed donations
People Helped: Estimated based on quantity and unit donated
Active Monthly Streak: Consecutive months of donations
Average Rating: Your rating from receivers
Achievement Badges: Unlock badges as you donate more
Monthly Charts: Visual breakdown of your donations over time
faqAnswers.whatIsImpactTrackerNote: 🏆 Keep donating to unlock new badges and earn achievement certificates!
faqAnswers.howToChangeLanguageIntro: AnnadataConnect supports English, Telugu (తెలుగు), Hindi (हिन्दी), and Marathi (मराठी):
howToChangeLanguageSteps: Tap your profile avatar in the navbar
Find the Language section under App Preferences
Select your preferred language (EN, తె, हि, or मरा)
The entire app will switch to your chosen language instantly
Your language preference is saved to your account
faqAnswers.howToChangeLanguageNote: 🌐 All pages including Help, Terms, and Privacy are fully translated!

terms.section1P1: AnnadataConnect is a platform that connects food donors with food receivers to reduce food waste and fight hunger in the community.
terms.section1P2: By using our app or website, you agree to follow these Terms & Conditions. The platform is available in English, Telugu, Hindi, and Marathi.
terms.section2P1: AnnadataConnect helps individuals, restaurants, homes, and organizations donate extra food to those in need.
terms.section2P2: We provide a connection service with features including real-time chat, OTP-verified pickups, location-based matching, and a trust-based rating system.
terms.section2P3: We do not prepare, inspect, or certify food. All food quality is the donor's responsibility.
section3_1Items: Donate only safe, freshly prepared, unspoiled food.
Provide accurate food details including title, quantity, type, diet type, and freshness rating.
Upload a clear photo of the food being donated.
Set accurate expiry dates and pickup locations.
Review and respond to food requests in a timely manner.
Generate and verify OTP during pickup handoff.
section3_2Items: Check the condition, freshness, and safety of food before accepting.
Consume food at their own risk.
Arrive on time for pickup within the timer window.
Request time extensions if needed (maximum 2 extensions of 10 minutes each).
Provide OTP to donor during pickup verification.
Communicate respectfully via the in-app chat.
section3_3Items: Provide correct profile details during signup (name, email, phone, user type).
Respect all users and maintain professional communication.
Follow local laws for food handling and donation.
Maintain a good reliability score by honoring pickup commitments.
Keep login credentials secure and do not share accounts.
section4Items: Sell food through this platform (donations only).
Share abusive, harmful, or illegal content in chat or listings.
Pretend to be someone else or create fake accounts.
Post misleading food information or fake freshness ratings.
Use the platform for commerce, fraud, or personal gain.
Repeatedly no-show for pickups without communication.
Harass other users through the chat feature.
Attempt to bypass the OTP verification system.
terms.section5P1: Food quality and safety depend entirely on the donor.
terms.section5P2: AnnadataConnect does not guarantee freshness, hygiene, or safety of any donated food.
section5Items: Illness, allergies, or health issues caused by donated food.
Any disputes between donor and receiver.
Any damage, loss, or misuse of donated food.
Inaccurate food descriptions or freshness ratings provided by donors.
terms.section5P4: Users accept food at their own risk. Always inspect food before consumption.
terms.section6TimerIntro: When a request is approved, a pickup timer begins:
section6TimerItems: The timer is calculated based on estimated travel distance.
Receivers must arrive and confirm pickup within the timer window.
If the timer expires, the request is automatically rejected.
Receivers can request up to 2 time extensions of 10 minutes each.
Donors can grant or deny extension requests.
Failure to pick up results in a no-show that affects your reliability score.
section7ModerationItems: Each receiver has a reliability score based on pickup behavior.
On-time pickups improve your score; no-shows decrease it.
Users with low reliability scores may be temporarily suspended from requesting food.
Repeated violations may result in permanent account blocking.
Suspended users will see a notice with the suspension end date.
Permanently blocked users cannot access the platform.
section8ProfileItems: Name and phone number cannot be changed after signup.
Profile photos can be changed up to 3 times per month.
User type (donor/receiver/both) is set during signup and cannot be changed.
Your exact location is only shared with approved request parties.
Donation locations are masked (approximate) until a request is approved.
section9RatingItems: Both donor and receiver are prompted to rate each other (1-5 stars).
Written reviews are optional but encouraged.
Ratings contribute to your public profile and impact score.
Donors earn achievement badges based on donation milestones.
Fraudulent or abusive reviews may be removed.
section10Items1: Modify or remove listings that violate policies.
Change features, services, or terms at any time.
Expire donations automatically past their expiry date.
section10Items2: Inaccurate location data from your device.
terms.section11P1: We may suspend or permanently remove users who:
section11Items: Misuse the platform or chat feature.
Share fake, unsafe, or misleading food listings.
terms.section12P1: We may update these Terms & Conditions from time to time.
terms.section12P2: Continued use of the platform means you agree to the updated terms.

section1Items: Name, phone number, and email address during signup.

privacy.section2Intro: We use the collected data to:
section2Items: Match donors with nearby receivers using location data.
Track donation statistics and impact metrics.
Award achievement badges based on milestones.
Send push notifications and email alerts.
Enable real-time chat between donors and receivers.
Save your language preference across sessions.
Improve app features, safety, and user experience.
Prevent fraud, abuse, or misuse of the platform.
privacy.section2Note: We never sell your personal data to third parties.
section3Items: Your exact location is stored to match you with nearby donations.
Donation locations are masked (shown as approximate) to all users.
Exact pickup locations are only revealed after a request is approved.
Location data is used to calculate estimated travel times for pickup timers.
privacy.section3Note: Location access helps provide better nearby matching and accurate distance calculations.
privacy.section4Intro: We take measures to protect your data:
section4Items: Row-level security policies restrict data access to authorized users.
Profile photos use randomized filenames to prevent guessing.
Password changes require current password verification.
Chat messages are only visible to the involved donor and receiver.
OTP codes are stored securely and verified server-side.
privacy.section4Note: However, no system is 100% secure. We recommend using strong passwords.
section5Items: Your name and contact details with the other party after a request is approved.
Approximate donation locations publicly (exact location only after approval).
Reliability scores and ratings publicly on your profile.
Data with law enforcement if legally required.
Anonymous, aggregated data for platform analytics.
privacy.section5Note: We do not share your data with advertisers or sell it to third parties.
section6Items: View and manage your profile information.
Change your profile photo (up to 3 times per month).
Control push and email notification preferences.
Change the app language at any time.
Request account deletion by contacting support.
Turn off location services (with reduced functionality).
privacy.section7P1: Our service is not intended for children under 13.
privacy.section7P2: If a child uses the platform, it must be under parental supervision.
privacy.section8Note: These services follow their own privacy policies.
privacy.section9Intro: We retain your data as follows:
section9Items: Account data is kept as long as your account is active.
Deleted donations are soft-deleted (hidden but not permanently erased).
Chat messages are retained for the duration of the associated donation.
Reliability scores and ratings are maintained for community trust.
You may request complete data deletion by contacting support.
privacy.section10P1: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time.
privacy.section10P2: By continuing to use the service, you accept the updated policy.
